name: Demandbase
description: Demandbase is an account-based marketing platform, sold as the Demandbase One suite, that identifies and prioritizes in-market accounts, maps buying groups within them, and coordinates marketing, advertising, and sales programs around those shared account priorities.
best_for: Enterprise B2B marketing and sales teams that want to align around shared account priorities, run account-level advertising, and measure which go-to-market programs actually drive pipeline and revenue.
features: Account Identification & Prioritization that finds in-market accounts and ranks them by conversion likelihood
Buying Group Intelligence mapping the decision-making group of contacts within a target account
Demandbase One suite spanning four modules: Marketing, Sales, Advertising, and Data
Coordinated campaign activation deploying targeted programs across marketing, advertising, and sales channels
B2B-native programmatic advertising campaigns run using account-level intent data
Sales Intelligence showing reps which accounts are actively in-market and who is involved, for focused outreach
Demandbase AI that prioritizes actions and tracks performance against pipeline goals
Data Unification connecting account, engagement, and signal data across marketing, sales, and CRM systems
pros: Describes its fee structure openly, even without numbers: "a clear platform fee that covers all the essential software and services" plus "a flat fee per user," rather than a fully opaque quote process
Bundles account identification, buying-group mapping, advertising activation, and sales intelligence under one named suite (Demandbase One) instead of separate point tools
Lists large, recognizable enterprise customers (including Adobe, Visa, Salesforce, and DocuSign) directly on its own site
cons: No published numeric pricing; the pricing page only describes the fee structure (platform fee plus per-user fee) and requires submitting a form to get a customized quote
No free trial or free plan is offered; its pricing page's calls to action are "Watch a demo" and "Book a meeting" rather than self-serve signup
As an account-based orchestration platform, its value depends on integrating with a team's existing CRM, marketing automation, and sales engagement tools

faq.question: Does Demandbase publish its pricing?
faq.answer: No. Demandbase's pricing page describes its structure as a platform fee plus a flat per-user fee but shows no dollar amounts, asking visitors to fill out a form so the company can "customize a pricing plan."

faq.question: What is Demandbase One?
faq.answer: Demandbase One is the name of Demandbase's product suite, made up of four modules shown on its own products page: Marketing, Sales, Advertising, and Data, plus Demandbase AI for prioritization.

faq.question: Does Demandbase offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Its pricing and product pages show no free trial or free plan; the primary calls to action are booking a demo or a meeting with sales.

alternatives.name: 6sense
alternatives.description: An account-based marketing and revenue intelligence platform combining intent data, predictive AI, and workflow automation to prioritize in-market accounts.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprise teams wanting predictive AI account scoring and AI-driven outreach automation alongside intent data.

alternatives.name: ZoomInfo Sales
alternatives.description: A B2B sales intelligence product combining a large contact/company database with buyer intent, website-visitor tracking, and conversation intelligence.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a very large contact/company database alongside intent data and engagement automation in one platform.
